# laravelforge_database_user (Resource)

Manages a database user on a Laravel Forge server. The only mutable attribute exposed by the API on update is the set of assigned databases (a list, not modelled in this pass), so all attributes here are create-only and changes force replacement.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the database user. Create-only.
- `organization` (String) Organization slug.
- `password` (String, Sensitive) Password for the database user. Write-only (never returned by the API) and create-only.
- `server_id` (Number) ID of the server the database user belongs to.

### Optional

- `read_only` (Boolean) Whether the user should have read-only access to its databases. Create-only.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp.
- `id` (Number) Numeric ID of the database user.
- `status` (String) Provisioning status.
- `updated_at` (String) Last-update timestamp.
